reviewer.type: AI agent plus deterministic local comparisons
reviewer.notes: The reviewer authored the development fixtures and knows arms, expected decisions, seeded defects and parent hypotheses. This is not independent gold or a human preference test.

methods.source_alignment: Ablations and full parents are compared with exact fixture source strings. Stability steps are compared with their recorded depends_on final and also with the original fixture.
methods.hash_checks: Every selected final is rehashed as UTF-8 SHA-256 and checked against final_sha256. The raw JSONL and fixture file hashes are retained.
methods.word_diff: Whitespace-token difflib.SequenceMatcher with autojunk=False; all eight immediate stability word-diff lists are included.
methods.fixed_point: Exact string equality and separately whitespace-normalized equality. Continued changes are not assumed to be uniformly harmful.
methods.seed_review: Semantic inspection of each known defect region. Rephrasing or a suffix change does not count as removal. Partial simplifications are credited.
methods.grammar_and_meaning_review: AI judgments are supported by exact local evidence; targeted rather than exhaustive. No outside factual claims were checked.
methods.prompt_scope: Arm labels and execution metadata come from the records. The ablation prompt contents are not independently reconstructed in this review.
methods.literal_checks: Exact spans and inner quote content are recorded separately; typographic changes can create exact-match misses without changing the value.
